notes: §1985:XV.3.2.4 GR8: a cd-name section runs after ENABLE, DISABLE, SEND and ACCEPT MESSAGE COUNT, and after a RECEIVE "that does not result in the execution of the NO DATA imperative-statement". DebugTriggerPlanner.PlanCd plans those verbs (not PURGE) with the CD area as contents, and CommunicationEmitter.EmitReceive lands the RECEIVE fire after the WITH DATA statements on the data path only; the witness covers ENABLE, ACCEPT COUNT, DISABLE and SEND. Probes at 85 (dbg/g8, g8b with an mcs.json queue): ENABLE OUTPUT and SEND fire, PURGE does not; ENABLE INPUT, ACCEPT MESSAGE COUNT fire with the area (QUEUE1); a RECEIVE that got HELLO fires after "WITH DATA"; the next RECEIVE ran NO DATA and fired nothing; DISABLE fires.

next.reason: 1985: "When cd-name-1 is specified in a USE FOR DEBUGGING statement, that debugging section is executed"; 2023: "USE statement rules cover only exception, I-O and BEFORE REPORTING declaratives; no FOR DEBUGGING; SEND uses message tags, not cd-name". No candidate has USE FOR DEBUGGING or CDs. The 2023 USE rules cover only exception and report declaratives, and SEND uses message tags, so the Debug module and the cd-name feature are gone.
